Welcome To Our channel Travelling Mantra!
I am Manoj Malhotra, and in this video, I am taking you on an incredible, soul-stirring journey to one of the most breathtaking island nations in the world—Mauritius.
While Mauritius is geographically located off the southeast coast of the African continent, the moment you step foot on this island, you are enveloped by an overwhelming sense of familiarity, warmth, and belonging. For an Indian traveler, visiting Mauritius is not like traveling to a foreign land; it feels remarkably like coming home.
